text.content:
Bearers of precious cargo, Couriers travel the world bringing important materials between people and places.

SKILLS

DELIVERY

Once per non-conflict scene, in a populated location, pick up a package. You and the GM establish where and/or to whom it must go.

On delivery, choose one:

  • 1 Fabula Point; or
  • (total level × 10) zenit; or
  • gain or strengthen a Bond with an NPC, location or organization relevant to the delivery.

You may carry up to five packages. Packages cannot be destroyed, but they can be lost or stolen through a Surrender.

SURVEY · SL max 5

During a resting scene, forgo normal restoration to regain only (SL × 10) HP and MP and recover from (SL) status effects.

If you do, choose an area within one travel day and gain one of:

  • reroll its next travel die; or
  • ask one question about the area, answered honestly; or
  • pick up or deliver a package there.

Survey's question clause can read a district's Miasma and Prosperity levels. Resting also lets you adjust Bonds, and since that is not restorative, forgoing restoration does not cost it.

SL max 5 is inferred from the audit's worked figure and has not been confirmed against the PDF.

SPRY AND TIRELESS · SL max 2

While carrying two or fewer packages: move one extra travel day's distance on the world map, after all other modifiers.

While carrying three or more packages: treat your maximum Hit Points and Mind Points as (SL × 5) higher.

(Printed at SL3; capped at SL2 in this campaign, giving +10 HP and +10 MP.)

FREQUENT GUEST · SL max 5

Services for traveling and resting have their costs reduced by (SL × 10) zenit for you and your group, to a minimum of half their original costs. After a resting scene or a travel roll conducted with the help of one such paid service, gain a bonus equal to +(SL) on the next Check you perform.

Both effects count toward the two-effect cap. SL max 5 is inferred from the audit's worked figure and has not been confirmed against the PDF.

JUST BORROWING IT · SL max 4

Spend 1 Fabula Point to declare that a package you are carrying is rare equipment worth up to (total level + SL) × 50 zenit.

Just Borrowing It never produces a hoplosphere. Hoplospheres are exclusively treasure: equipment and rare items only, never spheres or sphere-bearing gear.
